description: This file defines the DataGroupDao class, a Data Access Object (DAO) responsible for querying DataGroup and DataGroupPermission entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for retrieving data groups by name, permissions based on user roles and data group names, API permissions, filtered data group permissions, and all data groups. The class interacts with a database using a query builder, extending a base DAO class, and is part of the core authorization module.

classes.name: DataGroupDao
classes.description: A data access object for interacting with DataGroup and DataGroupPermission entities, providing methods to retrieve permissions, data groups, and permission filters based on roles and other parameters.

methods.name: getDataGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a DataGroup entity by its name.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Fetches DataGroupPermission objects based on data group names or objects, user role ID, and self permission flag.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Returns DataGroupPermission objects associated with a specific API class and roles.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Fetches DataGroupPermission objects based on a filter parameter object, including roles, API data groups, accessibility, and self permission filters.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Returns all DataGroup entities ordered by description.
